sections.title: Improvements
items: Improved Valhalla building selection across all ten levels using image-based identification.
Added responsive, per-building click targeting with hit-testing and Difficulty Choice verification.
Improved dedicated browser session reconnection and profile ownership safeguards.
Strengthened sign-in security with protected OAuth polling, one-time login result handling, and session safeguards.
Improved Tail Beast event waiting, commander dialogue preparation, and attack responsiveness.
Applied Arena automation fixes and reliability improvements.
